chunks.text:
[Shadow Falls]
{the lanterns gutter: a low organ chord hit, a fast descending chromatic run in the bass and lead together, a tom roll that drops into the driving battle theme}
positive_styles: cold minor-key sawtooth lead melody with tritone leaps
tight sampled drums with tom-heavy fills
uneasy dark battle theme, solemn and sorrowful rather than evil
